title: Temporary Recreation Coordinator: Crestmore Manor
note: Help run historic-house tours and events. Two years of relevant recreation programming experience are listed.
requirements: Two years leading recreational or community programs; driver license.

title: Recreation Leader I
note: Assist with recreation programs and community activities. Check current shifts and filing status.
requirements: At least 18; recreation experience desirable, flexible schedule required.

title: Community Services Specialist I: After School
note: Support after-school activities, sports and youth programs. Review supervision and experience requirements.
requirements: Youth programming experience and suitability for after-school supervision.

title: Museum Education Coordinator (substitute/on-call)
note: Lead museum learning programs and visitor activities. Relevant program experience is required.
requirements: Two years coordinating museum, educational or interpretive programs; completion of 12th grade. Education degree is desirable, not mandatory; license required.

title: Recreation Coordinator
note: Plan city recreation programs and events. This role requires prior program experience.
requirements: Two years of recreation programming or comparable experience.

title: Activity Leader I/II
note: Supervise activities and help run recreation programs. Recruitment may close without a fixed deadline.
requirements: Leader I: age 16+, some recreation experience desirable; Leader II: two seasons required.

title: Library Aide
note: Help patrons and shelve materials. A hands-on entry point to a library setting, with modest pay.
requirements: No prior experience; completion of 12th grade or current high-school enrollment. Physical shelving and customer service; must handle shifts.

title: Technical Specialist I: Inclusion Aide
note: Help participants join inclusive recreation activities. Expect active, people-centered work.
requirements: High school diploma/GED and at least one year of relevant inclusion or disability-services experience.

title: Librarian: Part-time weekends
note: Serve library patrons and support weekend operations. Professional qualifications may be required.
requirements: ALA-accredited master’s in library and information studies or an equivalent combination of training and experience; Class C license required. Supervisory experience preferred.

title: Librarian I (Substitute / On-Call)
note: Help readers and library visitors. Check professional librarian credential requirements.
requirements: ALA-accredited Master of Library Science (or equivalent training); a year of public library paraprofessional work is desirable.

title: IT Support Specialist
note: Troubleshoot devices and software across city locations. A mix of desk support and on-site visits.
requirements: Two-year technical-college coursework and three years of progressive end-user support, or an equivalent mix; valid Class C license. MCP or CompTIA A+ by end of probation; background check.
payType: Published or provider-reported rate; confirm with employer
qualificationSource: Employer posting summary; third-party leads need verification

title: Information Technology Services Manager
note: Manage IT staff, budgets, suppliers and infrastructure. A senior role, not an entry-level transition.
requirements: Typically bachelor’s in IT/CS or related field plus five years progressive IT experience, including two years managing people, vendors and budgets; Class C license and background check.
payType: Published or provider-reported rate; confirm with employer
qualificationSource: Employer posting summary; third-party leads need verification

title: Administrative Aide
note: Support city services, public inquiries and department operations. Mostly desk-based work.
requirements: Department administrative and public-service skills; review employer posting for exact education and experience minimums.
payType: Published or provider-reported rate; confirm with employer
qualificationSource: Employer posting summary; third-party leads need verification

title: Technology Support & Engagement Specialist
note: Help staff with technology and equipment on campus. Combines troubleshooting and face-to-face guidance.
requirements: Three years of technical support or customer-facing technology enablement preferred; communications and troubleshooting; A+ / Network+ preferred. Check official CGU requisition REQ-8535.
payType: Published or provider-reported rate; confirm with employer
qualificationSource: Employer posting summary; third-party leads need verification

title: Recreation Leader III
note: Lead recreation sessions and support events. Outside the SGV; appears as the radius expands.
requirements: See city posting for required recreation experience, certifications and physical duties.
payType: Published or provider-reported rate; confirm with employer
qualificationSource: Employer posting summary; third-party leads need verification

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst (ERP)
schedule: Full-time; hybrid program available, confirm conditions
requirements: Four-year degree with coursework in business, public administration, information systems or related subject and three years progressive business systems analysis. Tyler Munis ERP experience desirable. California Class C license.
note: Work with city departments to improve financial systems, document requirements, test ERP changes and train users. A senior digital option with limited outdoor movement. Applications are reviewed while the continuous recruitment is active.

title: Activity Specialist, Parks and Recreation
workMode: On-site; group programming and walking field trips
requirements: High school diploma or equivalent and typically one to two years of recreation-field experience. Experience conducting programs for youth is desirable.
note: Organize youth sports, crafts, outdoor programs and trips while supervising activity leaders. Located west of the SGV and suited to an expanded radius.

title: Senior Activity Specialist, Recreation Center
requirements: Two years of college study in recreation, education, physical education or related field, or two years of paid recreation experience. Review other supervisory requirements with the city.
note: Open and close recreation facilities, supervise program staff and support classes, events and senior services. West of the SGV and better for someone with existing program experience.
